_meta.name: EFB article JSON-LD templates v1
_meta.delivery: The pipeline assembles ONE JSON string (a single object with @graph, or an array of objects) and writes it to the post meta field efb_jsonld; the mu-plugin pipeline/snippets/efb-content-pipeline.php prints it in <head> after validating it. JSON-LD is never placed in post_content (kses may strip <script> for non-admin users, and the body must stay free of script tags).

supplement.use_when: The site's SEO plugin already prints Article/WebPage/BreadcrumbList. Verified on live HTML for whitestudio.team (EN): Yoast SEO graph with Article #article, WebPage (id = page URL), ImageObject #primaryimage, BreadcrumbList #breadcrumb, Organization #organization. AR is reported to use Rank Math and DE is unidentified (pipeline/00-DECISIONS.md) - NOT re-verified here.
supplement.why: QA-GATES E3 forbids a duplicate Article. A live article (fix-wordpress-not-sending-email-spf-dkim-dmarc) currently prints a second, hand-written Article next to Yoast's: do not repeat that.

standalone.use_when: The SEO plugin schema is disabled or the plugin is unknown (DE until identified).

_meta.placeholder_syntax: A JSON string that is exactly "{{NAME}}" is replaced as a whole value (escaping is automatic). Suffix :int casts to a number, e.g. "{{WORD_COUNT:int}}". Placeholders inside longer strings are replaced textually. Keys starting with _ are documentation and are removed by assemble_jsonld.py.

placeholders.PAGE_URL: Canonical URL of this language version, with trailing slash
placeholders.SITE_URL: Site root with trailing slash (https://whitestudio.team/, https://de.whitestudio.team/, https://ar.whitestudio.team/)
placeholders.PUBLISHER_NAME: White Studio Team (the brand is not translated)
placeholders.TITLE: The post title (same text as H1)
placeholders.META_DESCRIPTION: The meta description, 140-155 chars, in the page language
placeholders.LANG_BCP47: en-US, de-DE or ar (matches the site's html lang)
placeholders.DATE_PUBLISHED_ISO: ISO 8601 with offset; never changed after first publish
placeholders.DATE_MODIFIED_ISO: ISO 8601 with offset; changes only on a verified content update
placeholders.AUTHOR_NAME: The real author decided by the owner (not the bot user, not 'admin')
placeholders.AUTHOR_URL: Author archive or about page URL
placeholders.IMAGE_URL: Absolute URL of the featured image (JPEG, 1200x630 or larger)
placeholders.CATEGORY_NAME: Main category name in the page language
placeholders.WORD_COUNT: Integer; words in the body, excluding the FAQ answers if you prefer, but be consistent
placeholders.EFB_VERSION: Easy Form Builder version the article was verified with
placeholders.WP_MIN: Minimum WordPress version from readme.txt (Requires at least)
placeholders.VIDEO_NAME: Video title (the article title or the YouTube title)
placeholders.VIDEO_DESCRIPTION: One or two sentences, plain text
placeholders.VIDEO_UPLOAD_DATE_ISO: ISO 8601 date the video was published
placeholders.VIDEO_DURATION_ISO: ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT58S or PT1M52S
placeholders.VIDEO_EMBED_URL: YouTube variant: https://www.youtube.com/embed/<id> (use ONE of embed/content URL)
placeholders.VIDEO_CONTENT_URL: Self-hosted variant: absolute URL of the MP4
placeholders.VIDEO_VTT_URL: Self-hosted variant: absolute URL of the WebVTT captions
placeholders.VIDEO_LANG: Spoken language of the video, en (the video is English; DE/AR/FA are caption files)
placeholders.VIDEO_TRANSCRIPT: Full transcript, plain text, identical to the on-page transcript
placeholders.FAQ_n_A_PLAIN: Answer text, plain (strip HTML), identical in substance to the on-page answer

rules: Include VideoObject only when a real video is on the page; give exactly one of embedUrl or contentUrl.
FAQPage questions and answers must match the visible FAQ on the page (same wording, same count).
inLanguage must match the page: en-US, de-DE or ar. Do not copy English strings into AR/DE JSON-LD.
dateModified moves only when the content was re-verified (QA-GATES A5); never touch it for typo fixes alone.
HowTo is intentionally absent: Google removed HowTo rich results, and WPForms emits it on 1 of 6 sampled tutorials only.
Validate with json.loads before writing the meta, then check the rendered <head> after publishing (QA-GATES E3).

TechArticle.headline: {{TITLE}}
TechArticle.dependencies: WordPress {{WP_MIN}} or later; Easy Form Builder {{EFB_VERSION}}

VideoObject.name: {{VIDEO_NAME}}
VideoObject._note: Merge exactly one of _variant_youtube / _variant_self_hosted into the object and delete both keys (assemble_jsonld.py does it with --video youtube|self_hosted).

FAQPage._note: Items whose placeholders have no data are dropped; FAQ_5 and FAQ_6 are cloned from the last item when data exists (4-6 questions, never padded).

assemble.output: A JSON array of the emitted objects (each keeps its own @context). The mu-plugin accepts a single object or an array of objects.
